description: Flowora — Think. Draw. Connect. A free, local-first browser diagramming workspace.
name: flowora

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@flowora/shared && npm run build --workspace=@flowora/web && npm run build --workspace=@flowora/api
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@flowora/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@flowora/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@flowora/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@flowora/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@flowora/shared && npm run test --workspace=@flowora/web && npm run test --workspace=@flowora/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@flowora/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@flowora/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@flowora/api
